title: Very Awkward to Position So That It Can be Seen
text: Very Awkward to Position So That It Can be Seen. This product is nice in theory, but just impossible to position so that it can be seen BOTH on the nightstand AND on the ceiling at the same time. In order for it to be seen well on the ceiling, it has to be turned AWAY from you on your nightstand (or the numbers are backward/sideways on the ceiling), so you can't just turn your head to see it, or see it if you're on your side facing the nightstand.  If you're totally a back sleeper, and don't care about seeing the time on your actual clock, then this product is fine for you.  But it's very awkward for those who like to look at the clock itself, as well as see it on the ceiling.  Cord is flimsy too--not even as thick as a phone charger.

Easy to Use - This projector clock for bedroom with usb charging needs manual setting of time, not radio controlled, but is easy to do for anyone. Friendly for kids and the elderly.
